verdicts.reason: A: the watch case is cut off by the left canvas edge. The Monograph logo shrinks to a tiny mark next to the legal text, so the brand nearly disappears. The price is almost as large as the headline, so they compete for attention. Still, the headline, price, copy and CTA have clear spacing and a sensible left-to-right reading order. B: it has the same cropped watch and tiny, illegible logo, and it is worse because the headline runs into the 'Book a Fitting' button with almost no gap. The middle text block is cramped against both the watch and the CTA, and the legal text is squeezed under the copy.
